verdict.rationale: Viam documents its own model-integration path: users can bring their own model, push it to machines for local inference with versioning and rollback, and use logic modules that read a camera and command an arm. Nothing in the evidence mentions vision-language-action or robotics foundation models specifically, so how far this generic ML tooling extends to that class of models is unproven. Missing for 10: any documented VLA or robotics foundation model support, examples or integrations for such models in the autonomy stack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
